footprint.notes: CrowdStrike publishes very little about where it operates. The FY2025 10-K (the snapshot year, ended Jan 31, 2025) gives 10,118 full-time employees with no country or state split, describes a deliberately distributed, remote-first workforce, and names only its Austin headquarters, adding that it leases offices "in various locations throughout the United States as well as office space in a number of countries in Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region". The only geographic non-revenue figure is property and equipment plus right-of-use assets, recorded in $ thousands as filed (unit 'currency-thousands' is outside the lens enum); 'Other countries' ($54,194 thousand) is a residual and is not shown. No state-level figures appear in the 10-K; no company impact report was looked for beyond it.
